title: Communicating with the logical alien he called Spock

tellings.quote: I only saw two and the and Spock the first one he was um his tapestry

plain: In the early 1990s, at an overseas base, a former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says he was trained to communicate with aliens by thought, and that the first one he dealt with was so logical he called it "Spock". Sherman, who wrote of this in his book Above Black, tells Michels he "only saw two" such beings. If true, it means a US intelligence programme used people as telepathic go-betweens with non-human beings.
